challenge_comment: The mapping is partially correct. Article 11(6) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 correctly supports the annual testing requirement. However, Article 26 of the Delegated Regulation, while relevant to the overall ICT continuity planning, does not address the specific testing frequency. The mapping should be refined to reflect that Article 11(6) is the primary support for the testing frequency, while Article 26 supports the broader planning context.
